items.caption:
Wild sloths slept 9.6 hours, not 16.
In a small 2008 study, 3 wild three-toed sloths in Panama wearing brain-activity (EEG) recorders slept about 9.6 hours a day, over 6 hours less than previously reported for sloths in captivity (about 16). Happy International Sloth Day.
